title: resource_bounds results (issue #394)
description: Written by tests/resource_bounds/run_tests.sh from the fixtures' @rb lines (rb_result.h) and the budgets in budgets.json. Every number is a deterministic count or byte total; no timing is recorded or asserted.

budgets.description: Repository-relative path of the budgets file evaluated.

fixtures.description: One entry per fixture that ran, keyed by fixture id (ipv6-hash, tcp-memory, tcp-order, fragment-eviction).

exit_status.description: Fixture process exit status; 0 when every in-fixture check passed.

seeds.description: Fixed seeds and deterministic table keys the workload used, as 64-bit hex strings.

metrics.description: Workload scales, accepted/refused work and counters, keyed by dot-separated name.

checks.description: One entry per budget in budgets.json for the fixtures that ran.

limit.description: Resolved limit: the literal limit, factor x limit_metric, or the sum of parts.

baseline.description: Reported pre-fix figure the budget improves on, when one exists.

errors.description: Malformed @rb lines, duplicate keys, fixtures without budgets and results for fixtures that did not run; any entry fails the run.

observations.description: Optional platform observations (issue #395): the runner architecture and per-fixture wall-clock. Labelled observations only — no budget resolves against them and tools/ci/check-resource-budgets.py never compares them.

platform.description: uname -m of the machine that ran the fixtures.

wall_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds per fixture process, keyed by fixture id.
